note: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Dr. Fatin handwritten notes archive. Order = array order (insert anywhere). Item fields: id (stable, never reused), file (scans/...), thumb (optional thumbs/...), title, lesson, status (original | needs-rescan), notes, and links[] for future mappings ({label, url}) to assignments, readings, vocab, or produced replicas (docx/pptx/quizzes). A gap placeholder is {type:'gap', title, notes} — it holds a spot in the sequence for a page known or suspected to be missing. Workflow: drop the image into scans/ (and optionally a small copy into thumbs/), then add/insert its entry here — or use Curate mode in the UI to reorder, rename, insert gaps, register files, and Export this manifest back for commit.
